name.ja: プラノサウルス ブラキオサウルス

description.ja: 自分の手で恐竜を“知りつくす”ブランド『プラノサウルス』第10弾に、ジュラ紀後期の超大型竜脚形類「ブラキオサウルス」が登場！
description.en: Brachiosaurus, a gigantic sauropod from the late Jurassic period, is now available in the 10th installment of Planosaurus, a brand that helps you get to know dinosaurs with your own hands!

description.ja: • 「骨格ビルド」で恐竜の内部構造から知ることができる。
description.en: • "Skeleton Build" allows you to learn about the internal structure of dinosaurs.

description.ja: • 「恐竜ビルド」で骨格の上から外皮パーツを取り付けるプラモデルならではの仕様で恐竜の姿を復元。
description.en: • "Dinosaur Build" allows you to restore the dinosaur's appearance using specifications unique to plastic models, where the skin parts are attached to the top of the skeleton.

description.ja: • ニッパー等の道具や接着剤が必要ないから簡単に組み立てられる。
description.en: • Easy to assemble as there is no need for tools such as nippers or adhesives.

description.ja: • 頭頂部にある巨大な鼻腔や、植物を噛み切るノミのように鋭い歯の列を化石に基づいて立体化。
description.en: • The huge nasal cavity on the top of the head and the rows of sharp chisel-like teeth that chew through plants are three-dimensional based on fossils.

description.ja: • 腰よりも高い位置にある肩から伸びる長大な前肢を化石に基づいて立体化。
description.en: • The long forelimbs that extend from the shoulders, which are higher than the waist, are three-dimensional based on fossils.

description.ja: • 竜脚形類としては短めだが、捕食者に対して強力な武器になったと考えられる尾も再現。
description.en: • Although it is short for a sauropod, the tail is thought to have been a powerful weapon against predators.

description.ja: • 長大な首の筋肉をしっかり支える神経棘や骨同士の重なりによる強度の向上、頸の側面の空隙など、特徴的な頸部の骨格形状もリアルに表現。
description.en: • The unique skeletal shape of the neck is also realistically expressed, including neural spines that firmly support the long neck muscles, increased strength due to overlapping bones, and gaps on the sides of the neck.

description.ja: • 首は滑らかに可動するため、水を飲んだり地面の草を食べるために首を根元から下げる動作も再現可能。
description.en: • Since the neck moves smoothly, it is possible to reproduce the movement of lowering the neck from the base to drink water or eat grass on the ground.

description.ja: • 前肢の親指のみにある鋭い爪や、外皮からではわからない爪先立ちの形状となっている後肢も骨格を元に表現。
description.en: • The sharp claws on the thumbs of the forelimbs and the tip-toe shape of the hind legs, which cannot be seen from the outer skin, are also expressed based on the skeleton.
